notes.title: Price Drop
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

The game will be a year old at the end of November. In preparation for it's anniversary, I've gone ahead and dropped the price to $9.99. Hopefully this will allow more people the opportunity to experience the game. As always, drop me a line if there are any questions.

Thanks everyone,
Dorian T.

notes.title: Last Tile in Bestiary
notes.content:
Just so that everyone is aware, the last tile in the bestiary was intended for a very difficult optional boss named Eowyn. The basic graphics were created, as well as an idea of the boss' attack pattern. 

This was never implemented in the final game, but I've always bounced back and forth between adding it in an updated version. What are everyone's thoughts on an optional super challenging boss?

If there is enough interest, I can complete Eowyn and add her to the game. This will allow end game players to make use of the most powerful weapons and equipment.

notes.title: Darkblood Chronicles Updated to Version 2.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I've updated the game to version 2.1 which addresses the following:

- various minor unintentional bugs corrected
- various typographical errors corrected
- weakened Tepes & Revenant enemies in Sacred Remains
- weakened Malahyde Flesh boss
- weakened Caliph familiar
- strengthened Leo boss
- strengthened Samantha
- strengthened Aeon
- Creator familiar's Sacrament attack is no longer reflectable
- secret shop in Apartment now sells Love Potions & Poison Pills
- Poison Pill will reduce your relationship points to 0, making it easier to achieve all endings

If there's any questions, please feel free to shoot me a line. Thanks everyone.

Dorian T.

notes.title: Achievements Added
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I've updated the game to version 1.9 which adds 16 achievements. As well, typographical errors in item, weapon and equipment descriptions have been corrected. I am play testing this version live myself, having unlocked two achievements so far with no problems. Please drop me a line if you run into any errors. Thanks!

Cheers,
Dorian T.
